series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

dispositions.note: Contrasted with について (subject matter). によれば and kanji spellings are accepted.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Hearsay そうだ contrasted with appearance そうだ (Bunpro N4); the appearance-target items are jlpt 3 because the visible task is the N3 hearsay/appearance contrast (corrected CONTRACT rule). Hearsay targets report past events or states from a named source, because a present or future prediction with によると could also be read as appearance (e.g. 上がりそうだ); one appearance item is past (寒そうだった) so tense alone does not reveal the answer. らしい is left to appearance-impressions and the article.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Light cleft set (5 exercises): the learner identifies whom the frame singles out from the discourse (rejecting an apology, shifting blame, giving credit). Each instruction names its two candidates; the other person is introduced in the Japanese before the blank, and self-keyed items accept 私／僕／俺／あたし with kana.

dispositions.note: Interpretation: the と言える or と言われている ending is printed and the learner says whose assessment it presents (話し手, the speaker's own judgment, or 一般, a general or reported view); converted from slot choice after review because a と言われている completion stayed coherent in the judgment contexts. The と言われている target items are jlpt 3 because the visible task is the N3 と言える contrast.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Article mention only, as a fixed phrase.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: kato-sense is decided by position, and the position is the grammar point: in all three kato-reason items the question word sits inside the clause before かというと (私が…, 僕が…, 子どもたちが…), where どちら + clause is ungrammatical; どちらかというと is a fixed sentence-level hedge. Sentence-initial なぜかというと is taught in the article but not quizzed against どちら, because the two overlap there (どちらかというと can hedge an explanation). Items with 何 or 誰 were dropped because a hedge reading could not be ruled out.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: どちらかというと (どっちかというと accepted) as a tentative preference or hedged verdict.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved after two rounds; no new high or medium findings

findings.claim: Both と言える and と言われている allowed grammatical, coherent completions.
findings.change: The relationship became an interpretation item: the ending is printed and the learner types 話し手 or 一般; early-bird and hot-spring-skin converted for consistency; rationales no longer reject the other perspective categorically.

findings.claim: The instruction pointed to people named only in the hidden options.
findings.change: Per-item instruction 'Answer with X（reading） or Y（reading）' in a fixed order; tv-left-on and senpai-idea introduce 妹／先輩 before the blank.

findings.claim: お姉さんも妹さんも most naturally asks about the listener's sisters, so the respondent is not established as the older sister.
findings.change: Question changed to あなたも妹さんも…; last sentence 妹は犬が苦手で、猫が好きなの.

findings.claim: 静かであったそうだ was rejected although it meets the requested tense and style.
findings.change: 静かであったそうだ／しずかであったそうだ accepted.

findings.claim: The と言う spelling of ということだ was not accepted.
findings.change: と言うことだ／と言う事だ accepted with every accepted base spelling.

findings.location: kato-reason items (shop-crowded, quit-job; then walked-home, village-school)
findings.claim: Round 1: hedged どちらかというと fitted the reasons. Round 2: sentence-initial ____かというと cannot be decided by meaning.
findings.change: Round 1 replaced the contexts; round 2 moved the blank inside the clause (僕が____歩いて帰ってきたかというと…; この村の子どもたちが____…通っているかというと…), where only a question word fits; ledger row 132 states that position decides.

findings.location: どちら explanations of the 3 kato-reason items, article §7, ledger row 132
findings.claim: 'Only possible cause / nothing to weigh' claims were unsound.
findings.change: Claims removed; explanations argue from position; article §7 says both forms are possible at the start of a sentence, with different meanings.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved or superseded; no new findings

findings.claim: Typed mode hides the options that the instruction refers to.
findings.change: Merged with HNF-A-02: per-item instructions name both people with readings; self-keyed items accept 私／わたし／僕／ぼく／俺／おれ／あたし.

findings.location: why-japanese and the two other kato-reason items
findings.claim: どちら is ungrammatical inside the clause, so the frame alone decides the key.
findings.change: Superseded by HNF-A-06: all three items now put the blank inside the clause on purpose.
findings.disposition: superseded by HNF-A-06; position deciding the form is the grammar point and is labelled in ledger row 132

findings.claim: Same template with swapped nouns under different keys.
findings.change: beginner-can replaced by teacher-mistake (ID and key changed); nekojita-def became a question-and-answer dialogue ending in という意味ですよ; dog-walk-reason ends in explanatory のだ with a new reason; ryugaku-meaning became a question.

findings.claim: The ledger said によりますと is accepted, but it is not.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; no new findings

findings.claim: The prompts never mention 妹 or 先輩, so typed answers cannot be found.
findings.change: Both people introduced in the Japanese before the blank; instruction names both with readings.

findings.claim: The speaker's pronoun was not fixed and other correct pronouns were rejected.
findings.change: Self-keyed items accept 私／わたし／僕／ぼく／俺／おれ／あたし.

findings.claim: The question most naturally refers to the listener's sisters, making 姉 the answer.

findings.location: 7 そうだ items and 7 named-ending conversions
findings.claim: Instructions of 280–296 characters were too long for a phone.
findings.change: Instructions shortened to the reviewer's wording.

findings.claim: 'Natural hearsay in another request' was opaque.
